answers.answer: On Linux, copy the whole gpt-6-astra/skills/delegate folder into ~/.agents/skills so it ends up at ~/.agents/skills/delegate/SKILL.md (the README says ~/.codex/skills, or the CODEX_HOME skills dir, also works if your client lists it, but keep only one copy). The license: not found; the README does not state one, there is no LICENSE file at the repository root, and the repository listing shows no license for it.

Download the extension ZIP from the repository's downloads/ folder (or the project homepage), e.g. simple-gemini-0.1.1.zip, unzip it and use Chrome's Load unpacked. That file is probably not the latest GitHub release: the latest release is v0.1.0 (6 July, 'Initial public release'), while the README example ZIP is version 0.1.1; I could not list the release's three assets by name, so this is an inference.

Yes, it is the same project: github.com/workingyuanyuan/local-tts serves the README whose links point to the repo local-tts-sfx, so the repo evidently was renamed and the clone URL (with --recurse-submodules) is the one in the README. The speech weights need about 16.5 GiB of disk (in ~/.cache/huggingface/), plus about 7.3 GiB for .venv. It has been fully tested only on an RTX 5090 Laptop (24 GB) under WSL2 Ubuntu; other NVIDIA bf16 GPUs (16 GB+ recommended) should work but are untested.

It should call get_speech_job with exactly the arguments in the result's next.arguments (job_id, output_path, overwrite and timeline if present), repeating until the job completes; that is safe after an MCP restart. It must not resubmit the same text with generate_speech, since that would start a duplicate job; if the job_id is lost, use list_speech_jobs to find it.

Not documented: the README describes Kage as producing typeset HTML documents with 'screen-only delivery' and mentions no PDF export. To use it you need Node.js (the toolchain has zero external dependencies) and Chrome or Edge (for screenshots and pixel checks; set KAGE_CHROME if the executable is not found).

The cause is an Obsidian installer older than 1.4.5, whose built-in browser engine does not understand the colour-mixing CSS syntax the theme uses, so highlight backgrounds become transparent. The fix is to download and install the latest Obsidian installer again (vault untouched); the theme also needs Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer.

No, it does not work in Firefox (or Safari): it requires Chrome or Edge because it needs the File System Access API to write files, and the app shows a warning in unsupported browsers. The top level is 10, reached at 30 points (3 points per level, 30 points is the full semester score).
In Shinsekai set Base URL to http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 and API Key to 'none' (any string works), with LLM provider ChatGPT or Ollama. The code is under the MIT License.

Run ./install.ps1 -InstallDelegationTrigger from the project root in PowerShell 7, on Windows 11 (add -Force to update existing files). The -AutoApprove switch lets Antigravity (agy) run tools automatically without confirmation, and the dedicated worktree is only directory isolation, not a filesystem sandbox, so it could modify files outside it.
